summary.zh-CN: 指导如何用 Python（FastMCP）或 Node/TypeScript（MCP SDK）构建高质量 MCP 服务器，覆盖工具设计、错误处理、评测与最佳实践；附完整参考文档。
summary.en: Guides building high-quality MCP servers in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK), covering tool design, error handling, evaluation, and best practices; full reference docs included.

modifications.en: The four reference docs under reference/ are included unchanged.

conditions.zh-CN: 纯参考指南，不需要额外工具；实际构建 MCP 服务器需要 Python 或 Node.js 运行时，但这是用户的开发环境要求，不是技能加载要求。
conditions.en: Pure reference guide; no extra tools required to load. Building an actual MCP server requires Python or Node.js in the user's own development environment.
